payload.scientific_problem: Does a target-held-out route-distilled constructive prior place materially more production-sampler mass on queryable coordinated JAK2 transformations than a compute-matched uniform choice law?
payload.primary_model_output: A complete exact-executed COMPOSE program and canonical endpoint generated by in-loop route-prior selection among bounded generic compiled stages.
payload.central_claim_under_test: Routes from other T4 targets can shape a generic constructive reference law, while retaining uniform exploration, so a later FiberControl loop has queryable coordinated JAK2 candidates on which target reward can act.
payload.validation_setting: Zero-oracle matched generation on JAK2 seed 1 at delta 0.6; BRAF seeds 0 to 2 are a separately labelled breadth diagnostic for constraint-repair transfer.
payload.primary_baseline: uniform_same_pool uses the identical generic compiler, stage-candidate count, complete-program depths, exact executor and attempt budget, but chooses uniformly within each compiled stage pool.
payload.causal_ablation: route_prior differs only by the target-held-out additive A(site)+B(mode) score and a 0.10 uniform exploration floor.

declared_support.molecules: connected COMPOSE-supported molecular graphs with at most 40 active heavy atoms
declared_support.programs: existing generic Dynamic-v0 module families composed into 1 to 8 blocks and at most 32 primitives
declared_support.training: 7294 corpus-deduplicated constructive decisions; every row from the evaluated protein is excluded before vocabulary and model fitting
declared_support.runtime: no route, endpoint, target name, docking score or executable teacher program is loaded by the proposal model
declared_support.limits: The fitted prior covers constructive decisions only. BRAF pruning and QED repair are a breadth diagnostic, not assumed support.

promotion_and_kill_criteria.engineering: Both arms complete at least 95 percent of attempts, exact execution never disagrees with generation, evaluated-target rows are absent from every fitted prior, and oracle calls equal zero.
promotion_and_kill_criteria.jak2_promote_to_small_scored_fibercontro: route_prior produces at least one unique delta-0.6 COMPOSE-valid endpoint carrying the predeclared amide-plus-diamine-ring basin motif, produces strictly more such feasible basin endpoints than uniform_same_pool, and retains at least half the uniform arm's unique feasible yield.
promotion_and_kill_criteria.jak2_kill_this_injection: At 128 attempts route_prior produces zero raw basin endpoints and does not strictly improve raw amide or diamine-ring count over uniform_same_pool. Do not spend docking calls under this proposal injection.
promotion_and_kill_criteria.braf_generalization: Across all three BRAF cells route_prior must produce strictly more unique feasible endpoints than uniform_same_pool, including at least one from braf_0. Failure blocks a general cross-regime proposal-law claim but does not retroactively invalidate a JAK2-specific mechanistic pilot.

payload.scored_followup_if_promoted: A separately locked 48-call JAK2 three-arm pilot: q0 plus blind selection, q0 plus FiberControl, and additive route-prior proposals plus FiberControl, reported at 8, 16, 32 and 48 charged calls. No scored call is authorized by this contract.

operational_repair.failure: Both v1 launches stopped before worker creation because the new experiment module was absent from the inherited Modal image.
operational_repair.repair: Copy the complete local src tree into the derived Modal image after the inherited image is constructed.
